answer_2.quote: We use the following metrics for evaluating SCEs. Generation percentage (Gen) measures ... Counterfactual validity (Val) measures ... Edit distance (ED) measures the edit distance ... Readability (Flesch‑Kincaid) ... cosine similarity ... clustering ...

answer_4.quote: We randomly selected 50 examples from GSM8K, ... each example was independently assessed by two annotators (the authors), who determined whether the SCE yielded a solution matching the correct target label.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators were asked to judge whether each self‑generated counterfactual explanation produced the correct target answer.
